messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಹೆಣ್ಣು ನರಿ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಆಸೆಗಳಿಂದ ಅವಳ ಸೊಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರವಾದಂತೆ ತೋರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು, ಮತ್ತು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಅನೇಕ ಜನರನ್ನು ದುಃಖಭರಿತವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು,

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Kannada → English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|---------------------------------------|--------| | Ed | coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | and | OK | | una | indefinite article “a” (introduces a singular noun) | ಒಂದು | one / a | OK | | lupa | “she‑wolf”, female wolf, subject | ಹೆಣ್ಣು ನರಿ | female wolf | OK | | che | relative pronoun “who” introducing a clause | — (implicit) | — | UNNECESSARY (Kannada omits explicit relative pronoun) | | di | preposition “with” (association) | ಆಸೆಗಳಿಂದ | from cravings / with cravings | OK | | tutte | universal quantifier “all” | ಎಲ್ಲಾ | all | OK | | brame | plural noun “cravings, desires” | ಆಸೆ | craving, desire | OK | | sembrava | imperfect copular verb “seemed” | ತೋರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು | seemed | OK | | carca | adjective “laden, burdened” | ಭಾರವಾದಂತೆ | as laden | OK | | ne | preposition “in” (locative) | ಸೊಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ | in thinness | OK | | la | definite article (feminine singular) | — (no article) | — | UNNECESSARY (Kannada has no definite article) | | sua | possessive adjective “her” | ಅವಳ | her | OK | | magrezza | noun “meagreness, thinness” | ಸೊಂಪು | thinness | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | ಮತ್ತು | and | OK | | molte | quantitative adjective “many” | ಅನೇಕ | many | OK | | genti | plural noun “folk, people” | ಜನರನ್ನು | people (accusative) | OK | | fé | past‑remote of *fare* “made, caused” | ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು | made / caused | OK | | già | temporal adverb “already” | ಈಗಾಗಲೇ | already | OK | | viver | infinitive “to live” | ಬದುಕುವ | to live | OK | | grame | noun “grief, forlornness” (state) | ದುಃಖಭರಿತವಾಗಿ | sorrowfully / in grief | OK | | (resultative particle) **ಂತೆ** | resultative marker “so … that …” (required for “to live …”) | — (not a source word) | — | UNNECESSARY (added for Kannada syntax) |
---
### Items Flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: `che`, `la`, the resultative particle `ಂತೆ` (added for Kannada grammar but not present in the source). - **No MISSING or WRONG entries** – every source lexical item is represented in the Kannada translation, either directly or by a grammatical feature that Kannada naturally omits. - **No GRAMMAR errors** – gender, number, and case agreement are appropriate for Kannada.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 49: - Original: ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಹೆಣ್ಣು ನರಿ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಆಸೆಗಳಿಂದ - Issue: missing end punctuation (source ends with a comma) - Corrected: ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಹೆಣ್ಣು ನರಿ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಆಸೆಗಳಿಂದ, - Line 50: - Original: ಅವಳ ಸೊಂಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರವಾದಂತೆ ತೋರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 51: - Original: ಮತ್ತು ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಅನೇಕ ಜನರನ್ನು ದುಃಖಭರಿತವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
